Create a new ephemeral (short-lived, auto-expiring) tenant in a workspace

USAGE
  $ xano ephemeral create DISPLAY [-c <value>] [-p <value>] [-v] [-d <value>]
    [--expires-hours <value>] [-o summary|json] [-w <value>]

ARGUMENTS
  DISPLAY  Display name for the ephemeral tenant

FLAGS
  -c, --config=<value>  [env: XANO_CONFIG]    [env: XANO_CONFIG] Path to
                                              credentials file (default:
                                              ~/.xano/credentials.yaml)
  -d, --description=<value>                   Ephemeral tenant description
  -o, --output=<option>                       [default: summary] Output format
                                              <options: summary|json>
  -p, --profile=<value>  [env: XANO_PROFILE]  [env: XANO_PROFILE] Profile to use
                                              (uses default profile if not
                                              specified)
  -v, --verbose  [env: XANO_VERBOSE]          [env: XANO_VERBOSE] Show detailed
                                              request/response information
  -w, --workspace=<value>                     Workspace ID (uses profile
                                              workspace if not provided)
      --expires-hours=<value>                 [default: 1] Hours until the
                                              tenant auto-expires (1-24)

DESCRIPTION
  Create a new ephemeral (short-lived, auto-expiring) tenant in a workspace

EXAMPLES
  $ xano ephemeral create "PR preview"
  Created ephemeral tenant: PR preview (e4f2-9ab1-...) - ID: 42
    Expires: in 1 hour

  $ xano ephemeral create "Demo" --expires-hours 24 -w 114

  $ xano ephemeral create "Load test" --description "overnight soak" --expires-hours 24 -o json

[IMPORTANT] ALWAYS run --dry-run first and show the user the output before pushing. Push local documents to an ephemeral tenant via multidoc import. By default, only changed files are pushed (partial mode). Use --sync to push all files. Shows a preview of changes before pushing unless --force is specified. Use --dry-run to preview only.

USAGE
  $ xano ephemeral push TENANT_NAME [-c <value>] [-p <value>] [-v]
    [--delete] [-d <value>] [--dry-run] [--env] [--force] [--guids] [--records]
    [--sync] [--transaction] [--truncate] [--wait] [--wait-timeout <value>] [-w
    <value>]

ARGUMENTS
  TENANT_NAME  Ephemeral tenant name to push to

FLAGS
  -c, --config=<value>  [env: XANO_CONFIG]
      [env: XANO_CONFIG] Path to credentials file (default:
      ~/.xano/credentials.yaml)

  -d, --directory=<value>
      [default: .] Directory containing documents to push (defaults to current
      directory)

  -p, --profile=<value>  [env: XANO_PROFILE]
      [env: XANO_PROFILE] Profile to use (uses default profile if not specified)

  -v, --verbose  [env: XANO_VERBOSE]
      [env: XANO_VERBOSE] Show detailed request/response information

  -w, --workspace=<value>
      Workspace ID (uses profile workspace if not provided)

  --delete
      Delete remote objects not included in the push (requires --sync)

  --dry-run
      Show preview of changes without pushing (exit after preview)

  --env
      Include environment variables in import

  --force
      Skip preview and confirmation prompt (for CI/CD pipelines)

  --[no-]guids
      Write server-assigned GUIDs back to local files (use --no-guids to skip)

  --records
      Include records in import

  --sync
      Full push — send all files, not just changed ones. Required for --delete.

  --[no-]transaction
      [CRITICAL] DO NOT run with --no-transaction without explicit user
      confirmation; this disables rollback. Wraps import in a database transaction
      (use --no-transaction for debugging purposes).

  --truncate
      [CRITICAL] STOP and confirm with the user; this truncates live tables before
      importing.

  --wait
      After pushing, wait for auto-deployed microservices (tenant_deploy="auto")
      to become ready. Exits non-zero if any fails to deploy or the wait times
      out. Ignored with --dry-run.

  --wait-timeout=<value>
      [default: 300] Seconds to wait for microservices to become ready when --wait
      is set (default 300).

DESCRIPTION
  [IMPORTANT] ALWAYS run --dry-run first and show the user the output before
  pushing. Push local documents to an ephemeral tenant via multidoc import. By
  default, only changed files are pushed (partial mode). Use --sync to push all
  files. Shows a preview of changes before pushing unless --force is specified.
  Use --dry-run to preview only.

EXAMPLES
  $ xano ephemeral push e4f2-9ab1-xyz1
  Push from current directory (default partial mode)

  $ xano ephemeral push e4f2-9ab1-xyz1 -d ./my-workspace
  Push from a specific directory

  $ xano ephemeral push e4f2-9ab1-xyz1 --sync
  Push all files to the ephemeral tenant

  $ xano ephemeral push e4f2-9ab1-xyz1 --sync --delete
  Push all files and delete remote objects not included

  $ xano ephemeral push e4f2-9ab1-xyz1 --dry-run
  Preview changes without pushing

  $ xano ephemeral push e4f2-9ab1-xyz1 --force
  Skip preview and push immediately

  $ xano ephemeral push e4f2-9ab1-xyz1 --records --env

  $ xano ephemeral push e4f2-9ab1-xyz1 --truncate

note: Version/help are local; ephemeral list is the only authenticated CLI network operation. No --verbose. CLI may refresh its version-check cache.
